# telnyx_email_inbox_sender_filters (Data Source)

The sender allowlist and blocklist of an email inbox. Terraform manages both lists as a whole. The Telnyx API cannot delete them: destroy removes them from Terraform state and leaves them on the inbox.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `inbox_id` (String) The inbox id.

### Read-Only

- `allowlist` (Set of String) Senders whose mail is accepted: `user@domain` or `@domain`, in lowercase. Set `[]` to clear; removing the attribute keeps the current list.
- `blocklist` (Set of String) Senders whose mail is rejected: `user@domain` or `@domain`, in lowercase. Set `[]` to clear; removing the attribute keeps the current list.
- `record_type` (String)
